definitions: A piece of equipment used in pharmaceutical, food, and chemical industries to mix powders and form granules by applying high shear forces.
A machine that uses a rapidly rotating impeller and chopper to densify and agglomerate powders into granules.
examples: The high shear granulator improved the flowability of the powder.
Maintenance was performed on the high shear granulator.
Selecting the correct high shear granulator is crucial for product quality.
